name: Deleting a trip can be undone and the same trip comes back

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips in storage key ninety.trips.v1)
There are 3 trip rows and days used (data-testid=days-used) shows 64
Click the delete button (data-testid=trip-delete) of the trip row for 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-13
There are 2 trip rows, none for 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-13, and days used shows 49
Click 'Undo' in the 'Trip deleted' notification at the bottom of the page
There are 3 trip rows again, one of them for 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-13, and days used shows 64 and days left shows 26
